ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensures that the "Closed Lost Reason" field includes either "Timing" or "Budget", the "Next Contact Date" field is blank, and the record is owned by specific users before it can be saved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
( INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, 'Timing') || INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, 'Budget') ) && ( ISBLANK( Next_Contact_Date__c ) || isblank(Closed_Lost_reason_Free_Text__c ) )
&& text(Owner.Team__c )='Advertising' && text(Type )='New Business'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a Next Contact Date and Closed Lost reason (Free Text) if the Closed Lost Reason is Timing or Budget.
